title: See-Through Minimal 솔로 #065 · powerlifter bombshell · 레이어 튤 블랙 · 손 허리 · 봄 정원 테라스 · 야미카와
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, long curly golden blonde hair — wearing a minimal two-piece of a tiny bra top of two small cups on thin strings and a micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, both made of several gathered layers of soft black tulle, the material evenly tinted and softly diffusing so her own skin tone glows through it as a gentle blur, the rest of her body bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin across her whole body, including where the sheer material veils it, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms. The tiny garments show real material behaviour: airy tulle gathering in soft cloud-like folds over the small cups and the tiny triangle, the overlapping layers deepening to a milky haze, the thin strings pressing lightly into her skin. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
